prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a low-speed head-on collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1023; do not mention it.)
text:
We are writing to advise that this office now represents the interests of our client in connection with the motor vehicle collision that occurred recently, in which our client was injured. The collision was a head-on impact at low speed, and our client has sustained injuries that are being evaluated by treating providers.

Please direct all further communication regarding this matter, including any contact with our client, to this office. Our client should not be contacted directly by you or any representative of your company, and any adjuster or agent who receives a call from our client should refer that call to us.

We request that you provide the bodily injury liability policy limits applicable to the at-fault driver, along with a copy of the declarations page confirming those limits and any other coverage that may apply.

Please also take immediate steps to preserve all evidence relating to this collision. This includes photographs, vehicle data, recorded statements, claim file materials, telephone and electronic records, and any other documentation in your possession, custody, or control.
